body_md:
This creates a **new** Zenodo concept record for the P2 living paper, *Re-certifying the live Viridis OS decision kernels*. The record is created at the first weekly publication that has a compiled P2 paper, and gets one new version each week after that.

- **Creator:** Hart, Justin (Viridis LLC, ORCID 0009-0008-3082-2482). AI assistance is disclosed in the description.
- **Links:** `isSupplementTo` the canon records of the kernels it re-certifies, starting with Carbon Continuity (10.5281/zenodo.21855690).
- **Existing records:** this does not touch any of them.

Zenodo DOIs cannot be deleted.
title: Create a Zenodo record for project P2
